messages.subject: SNP 6.0 - unpaired copy number analysis with custom reference set
parts:
Hi,

I want to do a non-paired analysis over two set of CEL files: ces1 and
ces2.

I tried:

cbs <- CbsModel(ces1, ces2, isPaired=F)


But this doesn't work. How should I do it?

Your tutorial only talked about paired analysis and non-paired with
robust average, but not non-paired with custom reference set. Please
help.


Thanks & regards
Jason

Are you asking how you can use the robust average of the 'ces2' set as
the reference to each of the arrays in 'ces1'? If so, then you have
to create a reference set with the same number of arrays and the
proceed as in paired analysis:

# Create reference set (with identical files) of the same size as 'ces1'.
ceRef <- getAverageFile(ces2);
ceRef$combineAlleles <- ces2$combineAlleles;
ceRef$mergeStrands <- ces2$mergeStrands;
cesRef <- clone(ces2);
cesRef$files <- rep(list(ceRef), nbrOfArrays(ces1));

# "Paired" analysis
glad <- GladModel(ces1, cesRef)

I put it on the todo list to make the above a bit cleaner and less "low level".

Hope this helps

Henrik
